Messages.Author: Zortek
Messages.Body:
After wasting sufficient time muddling through the pontifications of "the
janitor" and the many well founded replies...I feel that it is my moral
obligation to tell whizs of the coast to "piss off."

I don't have the history with MTG or any card game other than Jyhad. I was a
member of the "new market" and Jyhad got my attention and my money.

My modest $600 investment in cards purchased at full retail is of no apparent
concern to the newly self-styled "mature company that is sensitive to the
political, religious, gender, and ethnic issues that are facing society today."

To hell with the political correctness involved with the semantics of the word
"Jyhad." The game contains...
mythical settings,
mythical themes,
mythical characters,
mythical plots,
etc.
The frivilous nature of this argument is so base as to drive me from the
market. I do not desire to be a piper to be followed and encourage no one to
follow...Each must do what is personally correct.

If you are so damn politically correct, consider the eyes of...

...the women, who are portrayed as monsterous and powerful or subservient to
male dominated influences.

...the gay family member, to whom you are perpetuating the western cultures
anti-gay tones.

...the Christians, to whom the concept of undeath to be immoral, evil, and
contemptuous.

...the Celts, whos gothic designs surround the Jyhad cardbacks.

...the children of the future, whose trees you are slaughtering to produce
your cards.

Come on, obviously a socially/morally conscious company such as yours is
taking all these into consideration...Plastic cards, genderless, sexless,
religionless, cultureless, and a game available to the general masses on a
sliding scale to account for the poverty level and monetary exchange rates.

I have learned a lesson from the wotc snafu, and I will now return my
attention and money to RPG's and archive these cards for my grandchildren.

#include <witty_sig.h>
#endif
/* Guess not...there is no wit in my tone */
Richard A. Wermske
zor...@neosoft.com
